_comment: Structural snapshot of the n8n workflow, taken by hand on 2026-08-28. Node bodies (SQL, code, prompts) are NOT here - run n8n/export-workflows.mjs for those. This file exists to catch the failure that has bitten three times: nodes silently disappearing when the n8n editor is saved from a stale browser tab. Compare node count and names first.
name: Family Council v2 - Chat (RAG)

nodes.name: Prepare Input
nodes.critical: Must assign 5 fields: user_message, userId, sessionId, is_full_pledge, image_url. image_url was silently dropped on 2026-08-28, which broke image reading.

nodes.name: Postgres Get Recent
nodes.critical: Also returns sessionMessageCount and lastMessageAtMs, which drive the accuracy disclaimer.

nodes.name: Apply Filter Logic
nodes.critical: Rate limit, duplicate filter, and the showDisclaimer flag (first message, or 30 min idle).

nodes.name: Is Full Pledge
nodes.critical: ACCESS CONTROL. Routes retrieval by access level. Deleted 2026-08-20, unnoticed for 8 days. Without it, non Full Pledge users get an empty context and a false 'no information' answer.

nodes.name: Retrieve KB Chunks
nodes.critical: Full Pledge branch. topK must be 20.

nodes.name: Retrieve Public Chunks
nodes.critical: ACCESS CONTROL. Public-only branch, filtered BEFORE ranking. Deleted 2026-08-20 with Is Full Pledge.

nodes.name: Identify Target Files
nodes.critical: Access filter (defence in depth), filename boost, and recency intent detection.

nodes.name: Fetch Target File Chunks
nodes.critical: Takes 4 query params; the 3rd and 4th drive the recency lookup and its access filter.

nodes.name: Resolve Latest Meeting
nodes.critical: Meeting dates come from fc_kb_queue.parent_folder, never from file names - a meeting folder holds the PREVIOUS meeting's minutes.

nodes.name: Has Chat Image?
nodes.critical: VISION. Deleted 2026-08-28; pasted screenshots were uploaded but never read.

nodes.name: Build Context
nodes.critical: Assembles KB sources + recency note + pasted-image transcription + document images.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.critical: Image rule is conditional on image_url; fallback wording is conditional on is_full_pledge.

nodes.name: Google Vertex Chat Model
nodes.critical: Feeds BOTH the AI Agent and Describe Chat Image.

nodes.name: Format Reply as HTML
nodes.critical: Markdown to HTML, document image attachments, and the accuracy disclaimer appended as a footnote.
